text: Yes, the 2023 tree-cover loss on the property is confirmed. About 4.5 hectares of planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda) were lost, representing 0.12% of the 3,643.5-hectare asset. The loss was detected by Hansen/UMD’s Global Forest Change data and corroborated by later observations (up to 2025) and the JRC 2020 forest reference map, which agreed on the entire event area. The change meets the minimum event size (0.5 ha) and tree-cover threshold (30%). However, the evidence does not specify the cause (e.g., harvest, fire) or legality of the loss.
